failure_adjudication: Preflight failures occur before fit launch; later exceptions keep FAIL. Only the unreaped owned H16 handle can receive TERM/KILL. Missing/partial worker artifacts, unsuccessful exit, watchdog/signal/restoration/count/resource failure, cleanup failure or finalization failure cannot establish a successful admitted fit. Partial worker files/logs/descriptors are retained; no retry/fifth process workload or cap expansion.
limits: Future root must stage the known common parent and exact readonly sources/metadata, fill qualified alias/runtime/backend/site-packages/disposition/review fields and freeze separate actual fit/admission with true authority before any launch.
Source review verifies enforcement/interfaces, not adequacy of2951/64-68GiB caps or actual warmedH16 resource/predictive success.
GPU free sample is a fresh observation, not an exclusive memory reservation or concurrency guarantee.

Worker-directory ownership is enforced by the exact caller through its own creation/identity checks; supervisor checks terminal artifact directory after reap. No adversarial concurrent-filesystem guarantee is asserted.
noncircular_admission: Supervision admission binds supervisor/source review/caller/common/arm/H/invocation/caps, then final fit scope binds that admission descriptor, then CLI binds final fit-scope SHA. No admission back-reference to that final scope hash.

required_parent_invocation.reason: caller.admission compares Path(sys.executable).absolute(), fit python_executable and native worker-scope alias exactly; invoke supervisor using this alias, not merely the resolved binary. Binary SHA is independently pinned/joined by the caller.

resource_boundary.ancillary_process: The readonly nvidia-smi query is a separate transient child with timeout15 and subprocess.run reaping; the sole wait4 contract covers the one H16 child. No unrelated workload signalling/reset/reservation occurs.
resource_boundary.child_cap: Immediately-before-Popen through sole wait4 includes complete child admission, imports, model/state operations, checkpoint/publication/restoration/final exit and observation latency.
resource_boundary.comparison_complete_field: Remains false in this one-fit closure source; named H16 terminal PASS/resource/count fields close the fit, no scientific/predictive comparison completion is asserted.
resource_boundary.parent_capture: Supervisor_capture_seconds/selfRSS/CPU include preflight common hash, availability query, post-child artifact hashes through pre-terminal capture. These are recorded separately and not constrained by child caps.
resource_boundary.parent_final_receipt_tail: Final TERMINAL write/print/exit is outside that supervisor resource sample; no whole-supervisor resource PASS is claimed.
resource_boundary.worker_CUDA_capture: Nonreset maxima from final worker_resources. External supervisor closes the worker publication/exit tail for wall/RSS.
